donors.observation: CardScanner.scan ran CardRepository.findCard(setCode, cardNumber, false) once for each of about 90,000 set cards on every JVM start. The Lab starts one bridge JVM per full game, so every game paid about 2 s of start-up for it (start to first decision 8.6 s -> 6.6 s measured on real 4P pods).
donors.fix: CardRepository.findAllSetCodeAndCardNumberKeys reads setCode and cardNumber of every stored card (day and night sides) in one query; CardScanner.scan tests membership in memory, with the per-card query as fallback when the keys can't be read. The stored-card test is unchanged: a set card counts as stored when any row carries its set code and card number.
